scene.label: Interactive 3D lesson network showing SBD-DC01 and SBD-DC02 on VLAN 10, each scanned locally with SCC from its console, with results collected on SBD-DC01 for STIG Viewer checklists and the findings record.
scene.completeCaption: Both controllers carry a dated, hashed SCAP baseline, three STIG Viewer checklists answer every rule, and one classified findings record, with the versions to reuse, waits for course 1.5’s Group Policy hardening and matched rescan.

nodes.name: SBD-DC01
nodes.title: SBD-DC01 · 10.0.10.10
nodes.description: Built in course 1.1 and holding the PDC emulator role. Lesson 2 installs SCC and STIG Viewer at its console; it is scanned locally, holds the evidence folder C:\Evidence\baseline, and is where the three checklists and the findings record are built.

nodes.name: SBD-DC02
nodes.title: SBD-DC02 · 10.0.10.11
nodes.description: The second controller. It gets SCC from the same verified media and is scanned locally with the same benchmark and profile; its hashed results are copied to SBD-DC01 for its checklist.

nodes.name: DC CONSOLES
nodes.title: DC consoles · Administration viewpoint
nodes.description: Until course 1.8 builds AdminJumpBox01, this course runs at each controller’s VM console with an authorized Domain Admin account: SCC on both controllers, STIG Viewer on SBD-DC01. Course 1.8 moves both tools to AdminJumpBox01 and removes them from the controllers.

flows.label: Hashed results to the evidence folder · SMB 445

chapters.network: Both controllers are live on VLAN 10 and unchanged. From each VM console you read the operating system, roles and forest to record which STIGs apply; nothing is installed yet.

Nothing crosses the network in this lesson: the content arrives on approved removable media at each controller’s console. SCC is installed on both controllers and STIG Viewer on SBD-DC01; the GPO package and the Windows client content wait, hashed, in C:\Staging\DISA.

SCC scans each controller locally from its console. SBD-DC02’s hashed results are copied to the evidence folder on SBD-DC01 over SMB inside VLAN 10, and no DISA policy has been imported yet: this is the before picture.

STIG Viewer runs at SBD-DC01’s console, with both controllers’ results already in its evidence folder. The manual checks are answered by examining each controller and the sbd.test directory they share.

The findings record and the handoff are written at SBD-DC01’s console into C:\Evidence\baseline. Both controllers wait unchanged for course 1.5, which imports the staged GPOs and rescans with the same versions.
